name: PlantNext XR Viewer
summary:
From searching through drawings to selecting piping directly in the field.

PlantNext XR Viewer is a mixed reality (MR) application that overlays 3D models of industrial plant equipment onto the real world, allowing users to access essential construction information directly at the worksite.

【Key Features】
・Display 3D models of piping, valves, equipment, and other plant components in mixed reality
・Select components to view their properties and attributes
・Search and filter by piping line numbers and equip
